title: Separation failure is a union of miss sets
statement: For any natural numbers $n,\ell,m$, every list of $m$ inputs in $\mathbb F_2^n$ that fails to distinguish all coefficient families on monomials of degree at most $\ell$ lies in the miss set of some nonzero such coefficient family; that miss set consists of lists on which the corresponding polynomial evaluates to zero at every input.
hypotheses_covered: natural numbers n, ℓ, and m
